findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md §Milestone 1 scope (lines 118-121, added by B-ec09) contradicts the §Milestone Routing table immediately below it. (1) The new paragraph says "M2 (Koala Runner CLI) is owned by the Mac/Runner repo", but the routing table defines M2 as "Python authority policy discovery (FU-5)" owned by the Cord Team Python authority — the Runner CLI work is M5/FU-4 in the table, not M2. (2) The new paragraph says "M3–M7 remain routed per the table below", but the table only enumerates M2–M6; there is no M7. Either the paragraph mis-numbered the milestones or the table is missing M7. This drift was introduced in this story (commit 14949175) and will mis-route any future reader who relies on the new cold-read paragraph instead of the table. Fix: correct the paragraph to (a) reference M5/FU-4 (or the relevant milestone) for Runner CLI ownership and (b) state "M3–M6" (or add the missing M7 row).
